basic_profile.bio: Hola! I'm a 36-year-old digital nomad originally from Madrid, Spain, currently exploring Latin America. I'm passionate about online gaming, particularly idle games, and I can't resist a good documentary binge on DiscoveryPlus. Standing at just 160 cm, I often find myself navigating the world from a shorter perspective, which has led me to embrace communities that share similar challenges and stories. During the day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to keep a flexible schedule. Evenings are usually reserved for gaming or catching up on the latest financial trends on eToro. Single and enjoying the freedom to travel, I believe life is too short to stay in one place. My typical online hours are late afternoons to midnight, local time, wherever I am.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Visual Arts from the Universidad Complutense de Madrid, which I complemented with various online courses in digital design. My interest in finance and investment started as a hobby, leading me to self-study through platforms like eToro and online finance courses. Additionally, my global travels have broadened my understanding of diverse cultures and languages, particularly Spanish-speaking regions.
